name: Music Assistant
description: Music Assistant is a free, open-source media library manager that connects to your streaming services and a wide range of connected speakers (Sonos, Chromecast, AirPlay, DLNA, and more). Host networking is required for local player discovery via mDNS/uPnP.

paths.name: Data Path
paths.description: Persistent data directory for the server's configuration and database.

paths.name: Music Path
paths.description: Optional path to your local music files.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Logging verbosity: critical, error, warning, info, or debug.
